title: smime-tree lib.rs has no crate-level doc
description: smime-tree/src/lib.rs has only a one-line module doc '//\! S/MIME sign/verify/encrypt/decrypt via key traits.' A contributor who found this on GitHub has no quick-start example, no explanation of how the four public functions relate to each other, and no guidance on what types to implement. mime-tree/src/lib.rs has the same issue. Both lib.rs files should have a doc comment with at minimum: a two-sentence description of what the crate does, a brief example showing the primary entry point, and a note directing the reader to the key traits (for smime-tree) or the parse/decode_body_value pair (for mime-tree).
